description: Retrieve one section of a compiled macro block blueprint (manifest, structure, slots, ports, rules, dependencies, provenance). Follow next cursors until complete. Optional designId pins aliases to that session registry.

componentId.description: Alternative block identifier alias matching idOrRef.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for large section reads exceeding packet limits.

designId.description: Active design session ID to retrieve session-bound block variants.

id.description: Alternative block identifier alias matching idOrRef.

idOrRef.description: Canonical macro block ID or SHA-256 content reference hash.

name.description: Alternative block identifier alias matching idOrRef.

section.description: Specific block section to retrieve: "all", "manifest", "structure", "slots", "ports", "rules", "dependencies", or "provenance". Defaults to "all".

name: get_macro_block
